item.title: Local officials, Bowen Health aid veterans with meals, services
item.description: Kosciusko County elected officials, in partnership with Bowen Health, are uniting to support local veterans through a Thanksgiving meal distribution and the launch of a new mental health initiative dedicated exclusively to those who have served.

item.title: Bell Aircraft Museum Craft Show Dec. 6 In Mentone
item.description: The Bell Aircraft Museum will be having its annual craft show from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. Saturday, Dec. 6.

item.title: Larry D. Beedy

(Hutchings) Beedy, whom he married Dec. 12, 1965, survives. item.title: Main Street Warsaw to Release Cultural Arts District Plan On Nov. 19
item.description: Main Street Warsaw and Designing Local, a national leader in urban planning and design, arts and cultural district planning have been engaging stakeholders and conducting research since the planning process was launched in April 2025 and have now completed the Downtown Warsaw Cultural Arts District plan.

item.title: Lilly Center Moves From Research to Restoration With Lake Rx Program
item.description: After more than 15 years of studying local waterways, the Lilly Center for Lakes & Streams is turning its research into action through a new initiative — Lake Rx.

item.title: Warsaw Community Public Library Board Holds Second Preliminary Determination Hearing On Renovations

item.title: Warsaw Common Council Approves Resolutions, Transfer Requests
item.description: The Warsaw Common Council approved several resolutions and transfer requests for multiple city departments during a council meeting on Monday, Nov. 17.

item.title: Yarian, Garber Named Republican Hall of Fame Honorees
item.description: Patty Yarian and Jon Garber were honored as the Kosciusko County Republican Hall of Fame Woman and Man of the Year Monday evening, Nov. 17.
